title: Find a value in a sorted array
summary: Find a book's position on a shelf sorted by call number by checking the middle and ruling out half each time.
goal: Find the position of the target, or report that it is missing

mapping.story: Part of the shelf still possible

examples.label: Find 5
examples.explanation: 5 is not on the shelf, so the answer is −1.

examples.label: One book
examples.explanation: The only book is the one wanted.

ladder.name: Check every book
ladder.idea: Walk along the shelf from the left until you find the call number or reach the end.

ladder.name: Check the middle, keep half
ladder.idea: Look at the middle book of the part still possible. Too small: keep only the right half. Too large: keep only the left half.
ladder.insight: The shelf is sorted, so one comparison with the middle book tells us which half cannot contain the target. Every check halves what is left.

approaches.name: Check the middle, keep half
approaches.summary: Compare with the middle and discard the half that cannot hold the target.

transfer.problem: A friend thinks of a number from 1 to 1,000 and answers each guess with higher, lower or correct. How do you find it in at most 10 guesses?
transfer.explanation: Each answer rules out half the remaining numbers when you guess the middle, and 2¹⁰ = 1,024 covers all 1,000.

selfCheck: Uses inclusive bounds and loops while low ≤ high.
Moves low to mid + 1 or high to mid − 1, never to mid itself.
Returns −1 when the target is missing.
